openings.claim: Common allowance may cause size-dependent errors; staged sewing could prevent repeated rework.
openings.discriminator: Consistent signed dimensional errors versus operator/design/direction effects.
openings.probe: Stage usable covers across sizes; record planned/cut/finished dimensions, signed errors, operator/design/direction and stage times; wash offcuts measuring both axes before revising cuts.
openings.uncertainty: Repeatability and time savings unproven; width shrinkage unknown.

openings.claim: Reference tables may miss customer geometry failures.
openings.discriminator: Different radii at similar dimensions versus nominal-to-actual discrepancies.
openings.probe: Get six customers' dimensions/corners, prioritizing nominal-only orders; compare reference acceptance with actual first placement before reversible pocket changes.
openings.uncertainty: Measurement accuracy and geometry variation unknown; six trials cannot establish batch success.

openings.claim: Concealed elastic gathering might accommodate corner radii.
openings.discriminator: Equal panels: fewer rounded-corner failures without puckering or square-corner failures.
openings.probe: Compare fixed/gathered offcut pockets on square and customer rounded tables through repeated placements before/after five washes; cost labor/materials and check schedule/layout before cutting.
openings.uncertainty: Requires adequate panels, balanced tension, washable elastic/seams, clear undersides and undistorted design; availability and durability unproven.

openings.claim: Whole-panel deficits may make compliant pockets insufficient.
openings.discriminator: Straight-edge shortfall persists with pockets released versus improvement from release alone.
openings.probe: Temporarily stitch first medium/large corners; compare fit before/after release, recording actual table dimensions, direction, operator and trial labor.
openings.uncertainty: Stitch removal must avoid cloth damage.

decision: Probe before commitment. Honor ordered sizes/designs, purchased stock, tool-free removal and five washes; retain two machines, <=350 units, three weeks, <=8% area waste (6.5% weight estimate insufficient). Require >=38/40 first placements and median total labor <=32 minutes; no supplied evidence establishes these outcomes.
